# Direct Response Copywriting

Write persuasive sales and marketing copy around a clear reader, story and offer.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use for persuasive copy across ads, headlines, landing pages, email, video scripts, product descriptions, sales pages and calls to action. Its direct-response approach centres the reader, hook, story, proof and offer.

Example request:

> Use direct-response-copywriting to draft a landing page for our product from these verified claims and customer examples.

Expected result: A reader-focused sales page with a clear hook, persuasive story, evidence and an actionable offer.

## A concrete example

This illustrative example starts from the source facts below.

**Source facts and constraints:** The source teaches direct-response copy through reader focus, hooks, story, proof and offers. This example makes no measured conversion claim.

**Before**

> Write ads and landing pages.

**After**

> Write the hook your reader wants to follow. Build the story with proof. Make the next step clear.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill direct-response-copywriting
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/direct-response-copywriting/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/direct-response-copywriting/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
